items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I get a call to come to the Apollo to play with the Four Brothers, there was [Gerry] Mulligan

ctx.x: You were based in New York.
I wasn’t thinking about leaving New York. And I get a call to come to the Apollo to play with the Four Brothers, there was [Gerry] Mulligan, Zoot [Sims], Stan [Getz] and I forget

who else was the Four Brothers. But I worked at the Apollo quite a few times with different bands. I would play at the Park across from Manhattan there, Palisades, play there for a week. I just played all around New York.
